title: reuse the numerator at an equal denominator
change_description: An exact identity arm returns the existing numerator when the selected denominator equals the rational denominator; the unequal branch retains the original integer multiplication and natural division verbatim. Unconditional equality covers all natural denominators and rationals, including zero/non-divisible denominators and non-dyadic values. No other arithmetic, threshold or fallback behavior changes. [Implementation and proof evidence](../docs/GEN25-SCORE-SCALING.md).
row_note: Proved equal-denominator numerator identity; full fixed/fresh 10M validation; clean fresh build; CPU 0; 3+21 ABAB
review_threshold: Both decode and CPR must independently reach 2/1; exact integer comparisons of measured medians; stop for user review only when both hold.
note: Preparation only: required combined/native/fixed/fresh evidence remains pending. No timing, benchmark build, archive, speculative measurement or throughput claim. prepare.py creates the execution plan only after those completed pass records are available.

reporting_helper.cpr_overhead: Report both implementations: signed difference of independent CPR/decode mode medians divided by the unchanged corpus count; retain noise and clock limitations.

requirements.pre_timing: Full gate/fresh/native independent passes, clean source commit, all other jobs stopped, unchanged frozen ABAB interleaver in decode and CPR, fresh measured worker with all source/C/object/trace hashes, power-plan and monotonic/UTC evidence.
